lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe8C4N4 (reduced formula Fe2CN) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies octahedral Fe centers coordinated by two C and four N neighbors, alongside tetrahedral N environments with two C and two Fe neighbors. These polyhedra connect into a three-dimensional network, where Fe octahedra share corners and edges and Fe octahedra also share corners with N tetrahedra.
